changelog:
semantic-prospect 1.0.1

- Clarified authentication requirements: SIMPLY_SEMANTICS_API_KEY is always required (no more mention of "no configuration required" for this key).
- Explained that third-party search API keys are not needed for free tier usage; platform provides its own keys for Brave and LLM.
- Added dedicated section on privacy, data retention, and data isolation, clarifying how lead data and API keys are handled.
- Improved free tier instructions and clarified API key management in all usage examples.
- Removed mention of SEMANTIC_PROSPECT_API_BASE override and cleaned up metadata to focus only on actual requirements.
- Made additional language updates to emphasize security, privacy, and correct integration setup.
summary: AI-powered semantic lead prospecting – discovers, qualifies, and enriches high-intent business opportunities from web communities, forums, Reddit, and public...
